forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, an email is on its way. The link is valid for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.
forgot.tooMany: Too many attempts — please try again in a few minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. All devices have been signed out.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
reset.tooMany: Too many attempts — please try again in a few minutes.
